paragraphs.text: Ygra , Eater of All , is one of the Calamity Beasts of Bloomburrow .

To the animalfolk of Bloomburrow , Ygra is enormous, the elemental cat 's giant body treading the ground and causing terror around it. Ygra is a giant cougar with green-glowing stripes, its muzzle marked by an unhallow light and numerous deadly teeth, and its eyes shimmer with an ominous gleam. Wherever Ygra stalks, life crumbles immediately in its wake, turning into pillars of salt.
A "Drought Cat" is identified as a Calamity Beast in the story. It is unclear if this is another name for Ygra.
